registry_info.name: alternative_geometries
registry_info.description: Non-Euclidean and alternative geometry artifacts — Möbius strips, bulging tunnels, rhizomatic structures, and spaces where parallel lines meet or diverge. Geometry beyond the textbook.
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Non-Euclidean geometry, Riemannian manifolds, topology, rhizome theory (Deleuze & Guattari), spatial perception

bulging_tunnel.name: Bulging Tunnel
bulging_tunnel.description: A tunnel whose walls bulge and contract, warping the perception of depth and distance. Non-Euclidean spatial distortion experienced from inside.

mobius_strip_altgeo.name: Möbius Strip (Walkable)
mobius_strip_altgeo.description: A walkable Möbius strip environment — traverse the one-sided surface and experience the topological twist firsthand. Non-orientability as lived experience.

non_euclidean_space.name: Non-Euclidean Space
non_euclidean_space.description: A space where Euclid's parallel postulate fails — rooms that are bigger inside than outside, corridors that loop impossibly. Hyperbolic and elliptic geometry made navigable.

rhizomatic_structure.name: Rhizomatic Structure
rhizomatic_structure.description: Rhizomatic growth structure inspired by Deleuze and Guattari — non-hierarchical, multiply-connected, without center or periphery. Any point connects to any other.
